steps.name: probe-and-skeleton
ac: test -f apps/api/tests/tasks/test_celery_app_lifecycle.py -a -f apps/api/tests/tasks/test_websocket_task_runtime.py
cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks -q --cov=src/tasks --cov-report=json:.coverage.harness.json

python3 tools/harness/assert_be.py apps/api/.coverage.harness.json --target src/tasks/celery_app.py --min-cov 38 --target src/tasks/websocket_task.py --min-cov 62 --target src/tasks/_ws_lease.py --min-cov 85
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/tasks/test_celery_app_lifecycle.py tests/tasks/test_websocket_task_runtime.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 6
git diff --quiet -- apps/api/src/tasks/celery_app.py apps/api/src/tasks/websocket_task.py apps/api/src/tasks/_ws_lease.py
